scope: Native-pixel screenshot inspection of stage, HUD, poses and identity; not a human balance or physical CRT playtest
observations: Original pointed cowl, cape and chest emblem identify Batman; red masked speedster, yellow ear bolts and lightning identify Flash.
30 different baked articulated poses per character cover 16 semantic animation clips. Punch, kick, airborne, guard, crouch, hit and KO silhouettes are distinct.
Cropped frame feet anchors maintain floor contact, with metadata mirrored consistently when facing left.
Health, meter, clock and round pips stay below the runtime score strip. Stage footing is visually continuous; city layers do not occlude combat.
limitations: Original limited-palette art does not claim commercial Street Fighter asset fidelity.
